verdict.rationale: The only evidence of backup/PITR capability comes from a community discussion where Supabase's CEO acknowledges nightly pg_dump backups caused write-contention issues during an incident and that the team is 'investigating moving customers to PITR and adding more backup controls' — implying PITR is not yet a mature, universal guarantee. No vendor documentation in this pack formally describes backup/PITR SLAs, so the feature's reliability and completeness can't be confirmed beyond this single community account.
